blocking_finding.finding: ServiceApplicabilityF8SourceScopeBinding is a publicly exported frozen dataclass with no result-object __post_init__ authority validation. evaluate_bound_positioned_subject_possibility accepts any instance and does not require the exact request/receipt nor invoke replay verification. A caller can therefore fabricate or dataclasses.replace a binding so an unadmitted source appears admitted and reaches the adopted F8 evaluator.
blocking_finding.why_receipt_argument_does_not_close_it: When receipt is supplied, evaluator compares only receipt.replay_identity() and receipt.receipt_id to attacker-controlled copies stored on the binding. It never re-derives the admitted set/provenance from the receipt.
blocking_finding.source_authority_effect: SERVICE_APPLICABILITY source eligibility can be manufactured outside the adopted owner.
